reproduction.command: uv run --isolated --extra run python - < <the recorded stdin_python payload>
reproduction.stdin_python:
import json
from pathlib import Path
from lectural.visual import dedupe_frames, extract_candidate_frames
video = Path(r"<path-to-video-with-the-recorded-sha256>")
out = Path(".tmp/real-sequence-candidates")
raw = extract_candidate_frames(str(video), str(out))
kept = dedupe_frames(raw)
window_raw = []
for frame in raw:
    if 419.0 <= frame.timestamp <= 446.0:
        window_raw.append({
            "name": Path(frame.image_path).name,
            "timestamp": frame.timestamp,
            "decision": frame.meta.get("dedupe_decision"),
            "alignment_path": frame.meta.get("alignment_path"),
            "alignment_result": frame.meta.get("alignment_result"),
            "first_failed_gate": frame.meta.get("alignment_first_failed_gate"),
        })
print(json.dumps({
    "raw_count": len(raw),
    "kept_count": len(kept),
    "window_kept": [{"name": Path(f.image_path).name, "timestamp": f.timestamp} for f in kept if 419.0 <= f.timestamp <= 446.0],
    "window_raw": window_raw,
}, sort_keys=True))
